benches.name: hier_xrv_diff_bench
benches.cmd:
B={RUN}/bsrc_m5_0; rm -rf $B && mkdir -p $B && for d in *; do ln -s $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && for d in $(cd physical/ref_tile/ot_pqc_t_ret_m5/src && ls -d */ | tr -d /); do rm -f $B/$d; cp -a $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && cp -a physical/ref_tile/ot_pqc_t_ret_m5/src/. $B/ && cd $B && { export OT_PQC_PIN=physical/s81_pq_hier/pinned OT_PQC_DEFINES='' && python3 tools/s81/pqc_xrv_bench.py build --work {RUN}/bh --jobs 16 && python3 tools/s81/pqc_xrv_bench.py run --work {RUN}/bh --record {RUN}/bh.json --jobs 32
}
benches.note: [m5rr: run on the 648e3800a snapshot overlay of physical/ref_tile/ot_pqc_t_ret_m5/src]
